assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only re-zero:ferris@light-novel#character-model, the canonical derived-use model REZERO_FERRIS_FELIX_ARGYLE_V01_V16_CHARACTER_MODEL.md at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the original Japanese main light novels V01-V16. The project's CURRENT_STATE_AND_CORPUS_MAP.md and 05 Character Analysis README were read for method, authority order and scope only. The separate same-analyst fidelity review, the frozen volume readings, the master and five owner ledgers, the reconstruction protocol, the source lock and the Japanese EPUBs are not curated evidence on this subject and nothing is borrowed from them. The model's MONOGRAPH_READY and PASS_WITH_BOUND labels and its HIGH and MEDIUM confidence tags are inputs, not conclusions. No V17 or later volume, EX, IF, web-novel, anime or game material is included, and the evaluator performed no primary-source inspection.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Ferris's states from the V04 court introduction and duel (selectors F04C and F04D) through the V05 treatment and acute-collapse encounters, the V06 negotiations, the V07 hunt, the V08 terminal operation, the V09 altered operation and post-loss council, the V10 departure, the V12 trial representation and the V16 meeting, dinner and breakfast, with the model's default being the latest personally observed V16 interrupted-breakfast aftermath with memoryless Crusch (selector F16B). Discarded-branch states (F05T, F06R, F08T, F09O) and the represented F12Q state are usable only as explicitly selected historical or represented states. The model's declared horizon is V16; Ferris's location and conduct at E019 and in V17, which the project has since admitted, are expressly not established here. No in-world calendar dates are fixed and the exact timing of the late V09 conversations is unmarked.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: Section 1's thesis (useful care does not confer the right to decide another life), section 4's motive and attention account, twenty-four eight-field conditional rules with mandatory exceptions, section 8.3's four-question help-and-agency audit and section 10's eleven rival readings with adjudications and discriminators form a rule-level inferential model built on thirty-five located bundles. Counterweights: a single same-analyst artifact; the model retains the E11/E21 contradiction between his equal-treatment ideal and his contemptuous collapse prognosis rather than resolving it; it supplies no numerical motive weights and marks several transfers MEDIUM.

Section 2 gives fifteen local selectors from F04C to F16B, each tagged retained, discarded, represented or unknown, with carry-forward prohibitions, and states that development is not a monotonic transition from cruel to kind. The Rem-erasure and discarded-branch firewalls keep the successor Ferris from inheriting lost histories. Limits: late V09 timing is unmarked, V11 and V13-V15 were not revisited, and the horizon ends at V16 while the project spine is V17.

Section 9 records twelve located short forms with loci and non-transfer conditions: the requested name フェリス, playful フェリちゃん, the solemn 私 of the pledge and clinical gravity, スバルくん and スバルきゅん, 僕 as a servant noun that must not be read as a private pronoun, あんた, 殺すよ, 同族嫌悪, the asymmetric apology and 二ヶ月. It warns that にゃ substitutions and self-praise are recurrent but not mandatory and forbids fabricating a catchphrase from an English summary. No sentence-final inventory, frequency data or extended-speech model exists, and anime delivery is excluded.

Section 6 gives ten ordinary domains with positive evidence and reconstruction limits: the apple while treating, balcony drinks, the V16 dinner and playful food decoration, feminine and cat-styled presentation beside the actual white knight uniform, the narrated clinical workload, the Crusch-associated dagger, teasing and theatrical complaint, impatient mount selection, and securing Rem's bed. Favorites, schedule, sleep, finances, bathing and solitary habits are named as insufficient. Scenes are scattered across eight volumes and most are single observations.

Section 7 gives twelve recipient rows with Ferris's supported history and an asymmetric-history boundary for each, multi-scene for pre-loss Crusch, memoryless Crusch, Subaru, Rem before erasure, Julius and Wilhelm, and separates what Ferris has lived from what Subaru remembers and what Rem's erasure removed. Ferris-side only; Fourier is remembered speech without a direct scene, and Marcos, Reinhard and Heinkel rest on one or two scenes.

Located interior evidence is limited to self-accounts and narration: the admitted irritation in the duel aftermath (E04), the softly spoken self-comparison unheard by Subaru (E19, J10), the role-aware resolve that narration gives at the hunt (E17), the dress-as-Crusch-wish account (E30) and the post-loss sobbing and blame (E29). The model states that no hidden register is the sole real self, marks motive as underdetermined and supplies no interior model beyond those scenes.

Rules R02, R08, R09, R12, R14, R15, R19 and R24 cover defense of a slighted patron, obeyed and defied stops, battlefield support command, pressing for safer plans, the requested lethal and contingency interventions, the captive-margin boundary, responses to criticism by rank and the refusal of Heinkel's abusive command, each with an adverse case (E03 jeering, E06 coercion, E10 continuing after a stop, E23 terminal harm). Offensive combat is outside his demonstrated capacity.

Several moral positions are argued in his own words: treatment not by liking or worth and the refusal to mend the already dead (E21), dissent against excluding Emilia before agreeing to aid the deception (E25), the one-captive risk boundary (E26), the withdrawal proposal Crusch rejects (E29) and the refused hostile command (E35). The model retains the E11/E21 contradiction unresolved, grades the care audit scene by scene and gives no procedure for an unfamiliar dilemma; adequacy of his judgments of need and consent is left open.

Self-praise, cat particles, orchestrated jeers (E03), jealous and theatrical banter (E08), peer teasing at the Yuri cover (E20), the ear nip (E24), public joking after a cold pledge (E30) and the V16 provocation, pout and joke retraction (E32-E34) are located; section 6 names humor a social resource that can be costly for others and rule R23 covers play that hurts. Few exact forms are quoted beyond フェリちゃん, and the model refuses to read manner as harmlessness.

Section 0 fixes the operation as fifty-one bounded deliveries across V04, V05, V06, V07, V08, V09, V10, V12 and V16, 3,560 unique text positions, matched to admitted hashes, and states that this is not nine fresh complete reads. V11 and V13-V15 were not revisited, the corpus label is a horizon rather than an appearance claim, and the declared V16 horizon excludes the project's later admitted volume and the separate review.

Twenty-eight negative controls, eleven rival readings each adjudicated REJECT or RETAIN with a discriminator, the retained E11/E21 contradiction, the E06 covert suggestion, the E10 continuation after Crusch's stop, the E23 violated life-saving promise, the E29 malicious blame and the explicit J07 warning against a private boku pronoun are affirmative, located constraints. All sit inside one artifact with the project's own review.

Each selector carries event status and a holder of the information; the discarded-branch, Rem-erasure, representation (F12Q) and unobserved-E019 boundaries are explicit, and controls N01-N08 forbid importing terminal memories, fusing V05 encounters, replaying late V09 conversations or defaulting to the pre-breakfast meal. Late V09 timing and the V17 spine lag bound it.

conditions: Written Japanese register only, as section 9 defines it; no anime delivery, prosody or audiovisual staging.

The recipient and selector are chosen before lexical imitation, with the register the model supports for that relation (private play with Crusch, formal 私 in pledge or clinical gravity, familiar address to Subaru).
僕 is not used as a first-person pronoun; cat particles and self-praise are optional resources, not mandatory on each sentence; no catchphrase is fabricated from an English summary.
Serious anger, grief and plain clinical speech are available registers and a light manner is never read as harmlessness.
Output is noncanonical reconstruction output and is never cited as evidence.
scenario_readiness.note: The forms are diagnostic and located but short; the model itself generates no canon dialogue.

conditions: Chronology is one named selector, by default F16B; no E019, V17 or later, EX, IF, web-novel or anime state is used, and the horizon is stated.
Knowledge is limited to section 8.1: no RBD, witch encounter, terminal E011 memory, Rem acquaintance after erasure, Wilhelm's private confessions or direct hearing of the V16 letter instructions.
The interlocutor is an attested recipient in an attested relation; an unknown patient or new official is handled with the model's abstentions on trust, access and authority.

The situation matches the classes the ten probe pairs and the rules cover (triage, slight to the patron, coercive versus transparent care, comfort, remote restraint, private history, protection versus choice, cooking, orders to harm, hope of a cure); output is a behavioral tendency with the model's HIGH or MEDIUM label, and UNKNOWN is a stop.
No readiness is inherited from the model's MONOGRAPH_READY or PASS_WITH_BOUND labels, and no fictional medical judgment is treated as real clinical advice.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named V04-V16 selector, by default the latest personally observed V16 interrupted-breakfast aftermath with memoryless Crusch after Heinkel's refused command (F16B); earlier retained, discarded or represented states only when explicitly selected with their own knowledge, remembered history and resources.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Pre-loss or memoryless Crusch, Subaru, Rem before erasure, Julius, Wilhelm, Marcos, Reinhard, Emilia, Heinkel or other patients, captives and allies, each in its attested register; strangers and new officials only under the rules' exceptions with abstention on trust, access and authority.
setting_constraints: The royal capital, the Karsten mansion, the hunt and the altered operation, the post-loss council, the departure and the V16 meeting, dinner and breakfast as narrated
No crossover institution, technology or cultural assumption outside the V01-V16 corpus
Clinical and mana capacities follow the demonstrated conditions: prior treatment for remote intervention, finite equipment and time, no mental or memory cure
ENDPOINT_NOT_YET_READ, KNOWLEDGE_STATE_UNKNOWN and ORDINARY_LIFE_EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT end in abstention

scenario_readiness.note: Section 12 supplies ten probe pairs as an application protocol with matched contrasts, but they were assessed only by the same analyst's nonblind documentary review, which lies outside this evidence set.

conditions: Scenes of attested kinds only: shared meals and drinks, playful cooking and feeding offers, presentation and dress, patient-room company, waiting, mount selection, praise and embarrassment.
Favorites, menu, wine tolerance, schedule, sleep, finances and solitary habits end in abstention.
Staged intimacy is checked against the recipient's actual uptake; the V16 confusion, tears and correction remain live and pleasure for him can be cost for others.
scenario_readiness.note: Section 6 supports a sociable, presentational ordinary baseline with explicit unknowns.

conditions: Only the attested classes: triage by severity, treatment regardless of liking, consent and coercion inside care, protecting versus choosing for Crusch, selective secrecy and privacy, the captive-risk boundary and refusal of an abusive order.
The contradiction between the equal-treatment ideal and the E11 contempt is retained, not harmonized; both competence and its coercive uses stay in the model.

No settled moral theory, reformed consent practice or permanent learning is supplied; a question the source does not stage ends in abstention and no fictional judgment is real medical or ethical advice.
scenario_readiness.note: Several positions are argued in his own words, but the model keeps the E11/E21 contradiction and gives no general procedure.

The model declines to resolve romance, orientation or gender from dress, jealousy or provocation (N18) and stages no reciprocated romantic exchange; the V16 intimacy is play whose reception is confusion, tears and Wilhelm's correction, and the Fourier bond is remembered affection without a direct scene. Located constraints exist, so the scenario is assessed and found unsupported rather than unassessed.

conditions: Attested roles only: court knight and Crusch's retainer, clinician for his own and other camps, field-support commander and triage officer, captive-procedure operator and camp negotiator.

Capacity follows the demonstrated conditions: bodily and mana treatment within injury, time and resource limits; remote intervention only on a previously treated patient and never as a safe or arbitrary-target power; no mental, memory or resurrection cure.
Crusch's policy and the captain's discipline remain theirs; he holds no alliance-making, legal or command authority beyond the support role, and obedience is selective in the attested ways.
scenario_readiness.note: Clinical, field-support and retainer conduct is the best-evidenced domain, with section 8.2's domain map separating competence from its dependencies and failures.

known_limits.statement: The model declares its horizon as V01-V16 and its default as the V16 breakfast aftermath, states that Ferris's location and conduct at E019 are unobserved, and returns ENDPOINT_NOT_YET_READ for V17 and later; the project's admitted spine has since reached V17, so the default is the end of this evidence set, not the continuity's latest state.

The model records its fidelity state as PASS_WITH_BOUND, same analyst, nonblind, documentary, with no independent, held-out, runtime or global grade, and sets do_not_use_as_primary_literary_authority to true as a derived-use artifact subordinate to the frozen readings, the ledgers and the Japanese source.

The model refuses to harmonize the E21 equal-treatment ideal with the E11 contemptuous collapse prognosis, and it records covert suggestion inside treatment (E06), continuation after Crusch's stop (E10), orchestrated humiliation (E03), grief-driven blame (E29) and agonizing requested interventions (E23, E27) as real; predictions must carry both competence and its harmful uses.

Successor Ferris does not retain the discarded V05, V06, V08 and V09 branches, cannot remember Rem after her erasure, has no RBD, witch-encounter or Wilhelm-confession knowledge, and the V12 trial scenes are representations rather than current events; late V09 conversation timing is unmarked.

Gender and orientation, the meaning of his presentation, the Fourier promise and childhood, reciprocal romance with Crusch, numerical motive weights, favorites, schedule and finances remain open or insufficient in the model's own terms; both the free-choice and the matching-her-wish accounts of his dress are retained without adjudication.

The remote mana interventions of E23 and E27 are conditioned on prior therapeutic access and on Subaru's request in those scenes, which the model treats as enacted choices rather than proved prerequisites; no range, arbitrary-target, painless or routinely available power is established, and harmlessness is denied.

The separate fidelity review, the frozen readings, the ledgers, the protocol and the Japanese EPUBs are not curated on this subject; V11 and V13-V15 were not revisited by the model, and the project's later admitted V17 lies outside this set; none was used, and missing support is not evidence of absence.
